e.title: Multi-Agent Claims Hack (Azure)
e.summary: Azure 多智能代理理赔黑客松模板（66★）：DocIntelligence+Agent Service+Semantic Kernel 专项代理
e.body: Multi-Agent Insurance Claims Processing Hackathon（martaldsantos/agentic-ai-hack，66★）是 Azure AI 多智能代理理赔黑客松：Azure Document Intelligence + GPT-4.1-mini 提取理赔文档、Azure AI Agent Service 建代理、Semantic Kernel 开发专项代理（Policy Checker 保单核查 / Claim Reviewer 理赔审核 / Risk Analyzer 风险评估）、Azure Container Apps 编排多代理协调、AI Foundry 监测与评估。对 RIAA：多代理理赔系统的动手教学（Semantic Kernel 路线）——与 [[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry/MCP 路线）互为姊妹模板；与 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]（欺诈检测代理）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（A2A 协议）对照不同代理编排范式。

e.summary_en: Azure multi-agent insurance-claims hackathon template (66★): Document Intelligence + Agent Service + Semantic Kernel specialised agents
e.summary_hk: Azure 多智能代理理賠黑客松模板（66★）：DocIntelligence+Agent Service+Semantic Kernel 專項代理
e.body_en: The Multi-Agent Insurance Claims Processing Hackathon (martaldsantos/agentic-ai-hack, 66★) is an Azure AI multi-agent claims hackathon: Azure Document Intelligence + GPT-4.1-mini extract claims documents, Azure AI Agent Service builds agents, Semantic Kernel develops specialised agents (Policy Checker / Claim Reviewer / Risk Analyzer), Azure Container Apps orchestrates multi-agent coordination, and AI Foundry monitors and evaluates. For RIAA: hands-on teaching for multi-agent claims systems (the Semantic Kernel route) — a sister template to [[claims-processing-hack]] (the Foundry/MCP route); compare orchestration paradigms with [[claims-fraud-guardian]] (fraud-detection agents) and [[insurancea2amcp]] (the A2A protocol).
e.body_hk: Multi-Agent Insurance Claims Processing Hackathon（martaldsantos/agentic-ai-hack，66★）是 Azure AI 多智能代理理賠黑客松：Azure Document Intelligence + GPT-4.1-mini 提取理賠文檔、Azure AI Agent Service 建代理、Semantic Kernel 開發專項代理（Policy Checker 保單核查 / Claim Reviewer 理賠審核 / Risk Analyzer 風險評估）、Azure Container Apps 編排多代理協調、AI Foundry 監測與評估。對 RIAA：多代理理賠系統的動手教學（Semantic Kernel 路線）——與 [[claims-processing-hack]]（Foundry/MCP 路線）互為姊妹模板；與 [[claims-fraud-guardian]]（欺詐檢測代理）、[[insurancea2amcp]]（A2A 協議）對照不同代理編排範式。
